hero.eyebrow: Career matching with you in the loop
hero.subtitle: Ariadne ranks ATS jobs against your CV, drafts a letter that sounds like you, and you apply on the employer’s site — we never apply for you.

items.title: Semantic matching
items.desc: Compare your CV to the role at a conceptual level — not keyword spam. See fit and gaps before you invest time.

items.title: Sounds like you
items.desc: The writer learns from your reviews. After a few letters, drafts sit closer to your voice.

items.title: Human in the loop
items.desc: Every packet stops for your review. Edit, rewrite, or approve — then you apply on the ATS.

items.title: Jobs feed first

steps.title: Upload your CV
steps.desc: Drop it once. Ariadne extracts skills, experience, and intent into a profile we use to rank ATS roles.

steps.title: Pick a ranked role
steps.desc: The Jobs feed is the default — Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workable. Paste a URL if a board is still missing. Explore is advanced.

steps.title: Review, then apply on the ATS
steps.desc: Writer drafts. Critic scores. You approve the packet, copy the letter, and apply on the employer’s site. Ariadne never applies for you.

security.title: Trust is
security.subtitle: Your CV and letters stay yours. Encryption, row-level access, and review-before-you-apply are built in — not bolted on.

items.title: Encrypted at rest
items.desc: Personal data and documents are encrypted and never sold or shared with third parties.

items.title: Row-level access
items.desc: Every request is authenticated. You only ever see your own jobs, drafts, and profile.

items.title: You approve first
items.desc: Nothing is submitted on your behalf. Human-in-the-loop is the default, not an option.

items.title: Private by design
items.desc: We keep the surface small: resume, job context, and the letter you choose to keep.

control.title: Built with you.
control.subtitle: Agents research and draft. You keep the judgment — edit, rewrite, or approve before you apply on the ATS.

items.title: Tone memory
items.desc: Feedback compounds. The more you review, the more it sounds like you.

items.title: Gap reports
items.desc: See exactly where you match and where you don’t — then decide how to position it.

items.title: Critic scores
items.desc: Structure, relevance, and tone scored before you even open the draft.

items.title: Rewrite loops
items.desc: Ask for a pass. Watch the pipeline rerun. Keep the version that feels right.

items.a: Yes. Create an account and use ranked jobs and packets. No credit card. We don’t ship a premium plan yet.

items.q: Does it work for any industry?
items.a: Semantic matching works on roles from ATS boards we can reach — Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workable — not every job on the web.

items.q: Will the cover letters sound generic?
items.a: No. The writer learns your tone from your reviews. After a few letters, drafts sit closer to your voice.
Your CV and personal data are encrypted and never shared with third parties. We use Supabase authentication and row-level access.
No. Ariadne never applies for you. You review the packet, then apply on the ATS yourself.
We don’t scrape them. We follow Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workable boards we can reach.

insights.fit_high: Strong overlap — the letter can be specific.
insights.fit_mid: A stretch on paper. Keep the letter honest about what you bring.

insights.quality_high: Ready to send if it still sounds like you.
insights.quality_mid: Solid draft — tighten anything that feels generic.
insights.quality_low: Ask for a rewrite before you approve.
insights.quality_none: Quality notes will appear after the review.

CookieBanner.title: Cookie preferences
CookieBanner.body: We use cookies to remember your preferences and understand how you use Ariadne. You can decline non-essential cookies.
